_doc: eflab progression oracle: numeric game data sampled from the eFHUB player export joined to the efootbase dump (2026-10-18). stats arrays follow BASE_STATS order; alloc follows TRAINING_CATEGORIES order; pos indexes POSITIONS. alt = [positionIdx, hubAptitude (1 half / 0 none), hub overall at that position] for every non-full position (proficiency penalty oracle, added 2026-10-18). Card 261 (last; change jump-from-gk1) is the one outfield card of the hub with a Goalkeeper 1 value (pos 4 DMF, alloc Aerial 8 + GK1 1, Jump 67 → 76); its efMaxOvr is null because the efootbase dump carries max_level 1 for it.
